# The RT64 shaders the web page builds before the game starts: one shader description a line, other mode L and H,
# color combiner L and H, flags, in hex. RT64 specializes each one's WGSL when the page is built and compiles them
# all while the page shows "Preparing graphics", so the game never draws with the ubershader, which integrated
# graphics can't afford (N64Recomp-browser's README, "Give RT64 a list of the game's shaders").
#
# Recorded from the page opened with ?record-shaders, which prints every description RT64 meets, at the page's
# default settings: the launcher, the Rareware logo, the title and the attract mode's demos of the worlds (about ten
# minutes of them, until they brought no new ones), the file select screen, a new game's opening cutscene, Spiral
# Mountain (Banjo's house inside and out, Bottles, the moat), the pause menu, the totals screen, Save and Quit with
# its game over sequence. Not yet: Gruntilda's Lair, playing in a world, Mumbo's transformations, flying, bosses,
# the quiz, the ending. A description missing here draws with the ubershader until its shader is built.
# Flags follow settings (filtering, HDR, MSAA, upscaling), so a change to one of those defaults means recording again.
